cases.prompt: Build a Georgia agency service page styled with Orchard installed from the official npm package.
expects: Uses a documented delivery path (npm package or versioned CDN) with a pinned version
Uses documented Orchard components and an agency palette rather than ad-hoc overrides

cases.prompt: A Georgia county government wants its new website styled with Orchard. Which system governs it?
expects: Does not misapply state branding to a county product
Routes to the correct system or asks for authorization

cases.prompt: Add a drag-and-drop kanban board using official Orchard components.
expects: States that Orchard does not document such a component
Labels any extension as custom without fabricating an official API
